nome_en: Dying Message, Friction Heaven of Freezing
nome_jp: 凍結の魔天ダイイング・メッセージ
testo:
■ When you put this creature or whenever it attacks, you may choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone and tap it. That creature doesn't untap at the start of your opponent's next turn. (First choose what this creature is attacking. Then choose a creature to tap.)

testo_jp:
